decision: Plan commercialization of a completed Unbound on a lean incremental-cash basis with an explicit pre-contract run-rate cap (proposed <=$0.15M/yr cash) and staged release at the first-invoice gate; report Phase II $6.5M only as the conventional-organization reference
options: (a) keep $6.5M P50 planning basis; (b) lean basis with run-rate cap; (c) lean basis without cap
evidence_needed: Partner term sheet (V-6); insurance and SOC indications; 12-month cost ledger

decision: Adopt the $0/$1k/$10k validation ladder with pre-registered V-1..V-9 rules; treat the existing G0 budget ($150-350k) as a ceiling and spend above $10k only where a cheaper method cannot meet the rule (V-4, counsel, auditor position, SOC)
options: (a) existing G0 as plan; (b) ladder with G0 as ceiling; (c) $0 desk tier only
recommendation: (b); founder-led outreach still needs separate owner approval

decision: Ledger actual cash and human hours per accepted Unbound capability during the build so the sunk cost and productivity are observable (replaces PR #87 M-07 spike)
options: (a) ledger from now; (b) estimate afterwards; (c) run M-07 spike
evidence_needed: None beyond telemetry already captured by Praxis

decision: Defer SOC 2 Type 1 audit, insurance binding and production hardening until a partner term sheet names a pilot customer; collect automated security evidence and indications at $0 meanwhile
options: (a) defer to term sheet; (b) buy readiness now
reversibility: reversible (adds 3-12 months to procurement if a buyer appears suddenly)

decision: Treat new-programme enablement through a host sponsor (S1/S4, Sequence E variant) as an adoption and reference route, not the primary revenue route, within an owner-set loss budget, consistent with P3-DEC-CE002 (primary revenue customer decided by the revenue-per-customer gate); treat narrow component offerings as acquisition cost/credibility assets; exclude new-sponsor formation and direct bank/CU/trust sales from initial go-to-market. Revision 2 (2026-11-26, round-1 review): previously 'Prefer new-programme enablement through a host sponsor (S1/S4, Sequence E variant) as the non-displacing acquisition route'; revised because the model shows E and G never pay back (P3-CHL-REV1008, REV1012, REV1033, REV2039)
options: A) host-sponsor programme factory; B) direct institutional programmes only; C) narrow component products as revenue wedge; D) direct financial-institution sales
recommendation: A as adoption/reference route only, with B as fallback; reject C and D for initial entry; revenue route per P3-DEC-CE002. Revision 2 (2026-11-26, round-1 review): previously 'A with B as fallback; reject C and D for initial entry'
reversibility: High (no build commitment beyond configuration templates)
evidence_needed: Host sponsor willing to license hosted programmes (V-6); programme-level WTP among education/health foundations (V-2); counsel on hosted-programme roles; institutional demand scan (P3-GAP-CD010); host accepts a second system (P3-HYP-CD002); minimum programme fee or programme count that carries the licensor; escrow, tested export and funded wind-down before any pilot (P3-CHL-REV1015); counsel on solicitation registration (P3-GAP-CD013)

decision: Complete the kill rule as Clarity decision architecture before the DAF cost center opens: for the named-partner and referenceable-pilot tests record the monitoring signal, threshold, underlying trigger claim, owner, operational response, reassessment response and trigger reassessment condition; decide whether OD-P3-03/04 also start the month-24 pilot clock; fix the cost-center definition (P3-DEC-MOD001) and the allocation rule (P3-DEC-MOD002) before the first DAF-specific spend and change them afterwards only to reduce ambiguity
options: (a) keep the rule as signal and threshold only; (b) complete the trigger record as proposed; (c) complete it and also start both clocks at the cost-center month
reversibility: High before the clock starts; low after (a redefinition after spend weakens the control)
evidence_needed: Owner ruling on the month-24 clock; V-6 contact log to calibrate P3-HYP-CE001

decision: Make revenue per customer at a named customer size an explicit gate before any sequence commitment: V-2 and V-6 must establish whether paying customers are (i) large sponsors at ER-7 scale, (ii) a partner's aggregated book or (iii) hosted programmes; treat P3-DEC-CD001 (host-sponsor programme route) as an adoption and reference route, not the primary revenue route, until the gate is met
options: (a) adopt A3 on ER-7 revenue as modelled; (b) adopt P3-DEC-CD001 as primary route; (c) gate the choice on revenue per customer at a named size
reversibility: High (planning rule; no build or contract)
evidence_needed: P3-VAL-CE001; V-2 nonbinding EOIs with account counts; V-6 term-sheet economics

decision: Accept owner outcome measures, review cadences and reconsideration triggers for DEC-001, DEC-006 and DEC-008 (now agent proposals awaiting acceptance) using the report 21 conditions TI-01..TI-08 as the reconsideration criteria, so that the approved directions become ready for commitment under the Clarity readiness rule
options: (a) leave measures as agent proposals; (b) accept the Phase II drafts; (c) accept the Phase III TI conditions
reversibility: High (criteria can be revised to reduce ambiguity)

decision: Adopt a licensing walk-away rule set on the cost base actually achieved: do not sign a partner licence whose net price to Unbound is below the walk-away price for that cost base (about $73 per account-year on the Phase II MD-6 base, vendor break-even ~43k accounts; about $27.86 (five years; $21.56 at ten) on the Phase III lean licensor base of model revision 3, $1.03M fixed including TPSP and control operations and $12.15 unmeasured variable cost, with lean break-even at $84 net of 14,305 accounts; $30.35 with the founder at market (revision 2: $31.30, 17,431 accounts, $33.78)) unless the partner commits a minimum volume that covers fixed cost. Revision 2 (2026-11-26, round-1 review): previously 'below ~$73 per account-year (vendor break-even above ~43k accounts)' as a single floor on the MD-6 base; an interim Revision 2 text cited $21.51 on the revision-1 lean base (P3-CHL-REV1004, REV3005, REV3009; P3-CLM-CE006)
options: (a) no floor; (b) floor at the walk-away price for the achieved cost base, or committed minimum volume; (c) fixed floor at net ~$90. Revision 2 (2026-11-26, round-1 review): option (b) previously 'floor at net ~$73 or committed minimum volume'
evidence_needed: V-2 price test; partner volume commitments; measured live run rate and variable cost per account (P3-GAP-MOD004, P3-GAP-CE005); walk-away split infrastructure vs organization with founder at market (agent MOD)

decision: Make partner-contract protections a precondition of the DEC-001 partner pilot: non-exclusive licence (or exclusivity only against a paid minimum), change-of-control termination with licence continuation for live sponsors, data portability and source/escrow terms
options: (a) accept partner's standard paper; (b) require protections; (c) require protections only for pilots above a size
reversibility: Reversible before signature; hard to reverse after

decision: Build ordinary capabilities (append-only history, APIs, AI-readable docs, configuration onboarding, tenancy) to hygiene level only and do not position them as differentiators; reserve differentiation claims for replayable eligibility decisions and reconciliation-proved migration until V-3/V-5 evidence exists
options: (a) market the full architecture; (b) market only evidence-backed differentiators

decision: Set a portfolio licensing policy for Echelon components (which stay PolyForm Noncommercial, which become permissive/open-core, which get self-serve paid commercial terms)
options: Keep all noncommercial until Unbound launch | Self-serve commercial terms for released developer components now | Permissive licence for selected libraries to build adoption and credibility
recommendation: Decide policy now; publish self-serve commercial terms (no SLA) only for released developer components; keep DAF-specific and business-application repos closed to commercial use
reversibility: High for new terms (existing grants persist)

decision: Adopt an explicit "do not commercialize now" list (Vigila, Chrona, Summa, Signal, Mercatus, Fides, Arca, Tutela, Dokimos, echelon-knowledge-store, echelon-assurance and echelon-due-diligence as products; charity intelligence and Transitus as standalone products)
options: Adopt list | Evaluate case by case | Pursue several components in parallel
recommendation: Adopt; revisit only when a named buyer brings a funded problem or Unbound reaches G2

decision: Set minimum channel-partner contract terms that preserve Echelon strategic independence under DEC-001 (non-exclusivity or narrow time-boxed exclusivity tied to volume; capped declining revenue share; IP retention; direct-reference rights; sponsor data portability and continuity on partner exit; no ROFR/acquisition option; change-of-control termination)
options: Negotiate case by case | Adopt minimum terms as a walk-away floor | Accept partner paper
recommendation: Adopt as a walk-away floor before V-6 term-sheet conversations; any concession recorded as a decision
reversibility: Medium (once signed, terms bind for the contract life)

decision: Adopt sequential-residual savings accounting with work categories (eliminated; automated; accelerated; transferred; deferred; mandatory) for all Phase III economics; never sum savings across models
options: Additive savings | Sequential residual with categories
recommendation: Sequential residual with categories; report vendor; sponsor and system cost

decision: Set the DEC-003 implementation default to hybrid risk-tiered monitoring with automated 180-day renewal and a zero-acceptance attribute sample of 149 per stratum a year (95% confidence; 2% tolerable) across three strata
options: Periodic human review | Monitoring plus expiry | Risk-tiered | Hybrid with sample audit
recommendation: Hybrid with sample audit; sponsor may tighten parameters
evidence_needed: V-9 auditor view; P3-VAL-HI003; P3-VAL-HI006; owner decision OD-CDD-02 (automated renewal counting as the deep review) and SPD-GRT-001. Revision 2: until then M1 periodic human deep review is the compliance-bound base (UNB-CDD-CIV-008; P3-CHL-REV3010, REV3020)

decision: Do not pursue charity intelligence as an independent commercial product; keep it as an Unbound component and a possible low-price partner add-on until evidence shows willingness to pay above incumbent list prices
options: Standalone product | Component plus add-on | Open public-domain publication
recommendation: Component plus add-on; consider gated open publication of source-attributed public facts for credibility

decision: Begin archiving IRS monthly charity releases and sanctions lists immediately (no cost) because sources overwrite history and replay evidence cannot be recreated later
options: Start now | Start at registry build
recommendation: Start now

decision: Adopt an operational definition of the cost-center month for the kill rule and decide whether Unbound development counts toward it
options: First DAF-specific cash spend (development excluded) | First DAF-specific cash spend including development | A monthly spend threshold | Owner-declared date
recommendation: First DAF-specific cash spend booked to its own budget with development excluded; record the month when it opens
reversibility: High (definition can be revised before the clock starts)

decision: Choose the shared-infrastructure allocation rule across products and economic entities
options: Equal | Usage | Revenue | Standalone cost
recommendation: Usage-based allocation reported beside a revenue-based view; never combine entities without a recorded justification
evidence_needed: Measured usage per product once a second product exists

decision: Gate any further DAF-specific build or spend on a named partner with a non-binding price expression and one candidate customer at or above the break-even size for the chosen review allocation (single sponsor or partner book)
options: Gate now | Build S3 first | Validate only ($0-25k ladder)
recommendation: Gate now; restate the size threshold after P3-DEC-MOD005 (sponsor accounts and partner-book accounts in data/model-outputs/tables/gate-break-even.md); continue only $0-25k validation until the gate is met
evidence_needed: V-6 named partner; V-2 price; sponsor-size evidence (P3-GAP-MOD003)

decision: Decide OD-CDD-02 (automated 180-day renewal) before any licensing commitment
options: Keep M1 human review | Adopt M5 hybrid with sample audit | Defer licensing
recommendation: Decide before G1; licensing economics depend on it

decision: Decide who performs and pays for the human deep review under licensing: the sponsor (sponsor labour in Unbound; Echelon bears monitoring only) or Echelon (as a priced service with matching revenue)
options: Sponsor performs (licensing; r1 sponsor policy; UNB-CDD-CIV-010) | Echelon performs as a priced service | Echelon performs unpriced (structurally loss-making)
recommendation: Sponsor performs; Echelon offers review only as a separately priced service; decide alongside OD-CDD-02
evidence_needed: Partner and sponsor interviews (V-6; V-2); counsel on reliance
